notes.title: Foreign Legion: Multi Massacre Update Released
notes.content:
It has taken some time, but after killing more than 500.000 dolphins, we've decided to finally release the full carrier level!

Additionally we decided to port yet another classic map from Foreign Legion: Buckets of Blood, and on top of that: Foreign Legion: Multi Massacre now features a new Team-based deathmatch mode.
For those who love to snipe we've added some hidden cute prairy-dogs as well. Go hunt them down!
